description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is Suzuki OEM Door Panel Kit (This is the style currently in production).
You Get It All With This Kit!
Along with the Door Panels you also get the Door Pulls, Door Handle, Handle Bezels, Window Cranks & Escutcheons, Door Stop Straps & Covers and Door Panel Clips
These parts do BOTH doors LH & RH.
This is everything you need to completely renew the appearance of your doors with the added confidence that you are installing Genuine Suzuki Parts rather than inferior after-market parts.
Has Attachment Clip Slots Pre-Cut into the Back of the Panel.
Has all Required Openings Pre-Cut to Accept the Door Bezels, Door Pulls, Regulator Handles and Limit Straps.
Made from Black Vinyl over Hardboard.
Direct Replacement
Note: Door Panels have minor damage on top point (may be broke, bent or showing backing material)
Easy Installation
Install Exactly Like the Parts You Are Replacing.
No Surprises!Installs in 45 minutes from start to finish
See Photographs above for Installation Instructions Comes with All-New Door Clips
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Door Panels
Qty 2 – Door Pulls
Qty 2 – Door Handles
Qty 2 – Handle Bezels
Qty 2 – Window Cranks & Escutcheons (Includes retainer clips for cranks)
Qty 2 – Door Stop Straps & Covers
Qty 22 – Door Panel Clips (11 Per Door Panel)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1994 – 1995 All Models
